ai_briefing.morning_summary: Major cryptocurrencies slipped on the Delta India exchange, with BTC down 0.6% to $82,619 and ETH falling 2.5% to $2,504. Broad‑based weakness was highlighted by outflows from Bitcoin and Ether ETFs, while XRP ETFs showed modest inflows. Market participants should watch the fallout from recent high‑profile legal actions and the emerging Bitcoin lending infrastructure.
